scope: Three actual finite lock mechanisms; ordinary-data RC11 publication controls; saved IF/nested-node real interrupt guest; equal-work native and two-node Linux VM observations.
limits: No physical NUMA/cache-traffic/WCET or arbitrary fairness claim.
GenMC spin-assume and selected RC11 program do not prove liveness or arbitrary programs.
Selected algorithm counters omit validation/admission operations; CPU affinity does not establish page placement.
External human review and independent learner assessment remain separate.
